author: Russell Brand
description:
Tommy Robinson joins me for a candid conversation about immigration, national identity and the future of Britain. We explore his views on Islam, cultural change and demographic shifts, while I push on questions of coexistence, assimilation and whether communities with very different beliefs can realistically live together in the same country. As the discussion unfolds, we move into bigger questions about power, technology and whether direct democracy could reshape politics in a deeply divided society.

description:
